blog.title: How to Thrive in Palia: A Complete Guide to Skills, Relationships, and Progression
blog.description: Master Palia with this complete guide to skills, crafting, relationships, housing, and long-term progression.

meta.og:title: How to Thrive in Palia: A Complete Guide to Skills, Relationships, and Progression - Best Review & H5 Games Hub
meta.twitter:title: How to Thrive in Palia: A Complete Guide to Skills, Relationships, and Progression - Best Review & H5 Games Hub

news.content:
Palia is a cozy MMO that blends life simulation with adventure, crafting, and community building. Set in a vibrant world filled with charming characters and relaxing activities, it invites players to forge their own path—whether through farming, fishing, cooking, or forming friendships. But beneath its tranquil surface lies a complex web of systems that can overwhelm new players. This guide breaks down the journey into ten progressive sections, helping you master Palia’s mechanics and make the most of your time in Kilima and Bahari Bay.

  1. Getting Started: Your First Days in Palia After character creation, you’ll begin in Kilima Village with a basic tutorial questline. Complete this to unlock essential tools like the axe, pickaxe, bow, and fishing rod. These tools are tied to Palia’s eight core skills, each of which levels independently.

Talk to every villager early on to unlock relationship quests and weekly wants. These interactions are key to gaining Renown, unlocking recipes, and expanding your housing plot. Don’t rush—Palia rewards patience and curiosity.

Checklist:

  • Complete “Welcome to Palia” quest
  • Unlock all basic tools
  • Meet every villager
  1. Leveling Skills Efficiently Palia’s eight skills—Foraging, Mining, Hunting, Fishing, Cooking, Gardening, Furniture Making, and Insect Catching—level up through use. Focus is a key mechanic: eating food boosts your Focus bar, which increases XP gain.

Start by cooking simple dishes like Grilled Mushrooms to maintain Focus. Then rotate between activities to avoid burnout and maximize progression. Upgraded tools unlock new nodes and recipes, so prioritize skill leveling early.

Tips:

  • Eat before gathering to boost XP
  • Upgrade tools at the relevant guild
  • Rotate skills to avoid grind fatigue
  1. Making Money: Early and Long-Term Strategies Gold is essential for buying furniture, recipes, and expanding your plot. Early on, sell fish, bugs, and Sernuk drops. Fishing in pools yields higher-quality fish, while hunting near Whispering Banks can net valuable antlers.

Later, gardening and cooking become lucrative. High-tier crops and dishes sell for more, especially when crafted with rare ingredients. Use the Storage Bin to sell items directly from your plot.

Best Money Sources:

  • Fishing Pools (Kilima Lake)
  • Sernuk Antlers (Whispering Banks)
  • High-tier dishes (Spicy Rice, Celebration Cake)
  1. Building Relationships with Villagers Villagers offer quests, gifts, and lore. Each has favorite gifts and weekly wants—giving these boosts your relationship level, unlocking new dialogue and rewards. Use the Relationship tab to track progress.

Some villagers offer skill bonuses or exclusive recipes. For example, Ashura helps with hunting, while Reth unlocks cooking upgrades. Prioritize relationships based on your preferred playstyle.

Relationship Tips:

  • Check weekly wants every Monday
  • Give favorite gifts for max XP
  • Complete personal quests for Renown
  1. Expanding and Decorating Your Housing Plot Your housing plot starts small but can be expanded using Renown. Build new rooms, place furniture, and decorate with themes. Furniture affects comfort, which boosts Focus regeneration.

Use the Furniture Making skill to craft items, or buy blueprints from Tish. Decorating isn’t just aesthetic—it improves gameplay. High-comfort homes make skill grinding easier.

Decorating Tips:

  • Use matching sets for comfort bonuses
  • Craft furniture to save gold
  • Expand plot for more farming space
  1. Mastering Gardening and Cooking Gardening and Cooking are deeply intertwined. Grow crops like tomatoes, rice, and mushrooms, then use them in recipes. Watering, fertilizing, and harvesting all contribute to Gardening XP.

Cooking involves timing and ingredient management. Use the Cooking Station and Prep Table to make dishes. Higher-level recipes require more steps but yield better Focus and gold.

Crop Tips:

  • Use fertilizer for faster growth
  • Plant in rows for easy harvesting
  • Cook dishes that match your skill goals
  1. Exploring Kilima and Bahari Bay Palia’s two main zones offer unique resources and biomes. Kilima is beginner-friendly, while Bahari Bay has rare bugs, fish, and mining nodes. Use fast travel points marked by horseshoes to move quickly.

Each zone has secrets—hidden caves, rare spawns, and lore items. Explore thoroughly and mark points of interest on your map. Use the Return Home button to avoid long treks.

Exploration Tips:

  • Unlock all fast travel points
  • Check for rare spawns at dawn/dusk
  • Use map markers for resource tracking
  1. Joining the Community and Multiplayer Features Palia encourages social play. You can join parties, visit friends’ plots, and participate in community events. Use in-game chat or Discord to coordinate activities like hunting or gardening.

Multiplayer bonuses include shared XP and loot. Helping others with tasks like watering or cooking benefits both players. Be respectful—Palia has a strong etiquette culture.

Social Tips:

  • Join Discord for event coordination
  • Use emotes and chat to interact
  • Help others to earn Renown
  1. Managing Inventory and Storage Inventory space is limited early on. Use Storage Chests and Cabinets to organize items. Label containers by category—fish, bugs, crops, etc.—to streamline crafting and selling.

Upgrade your backpack at the general store to increase carry capacity. Use the Storage Bin to sell items directly from your plot, saving time and effort.

Storage Tips:

  • Craft multiple chests for sorting
  • Upgrade backpack ASAP
  • Use Storage Bin for bulk selling
  1. Planning for Long-Term Progression Palia is designed for long-term play. Set goals—maxing skills, unlocking all recipes, completing relationship quests—and work toward them gradually. Renown is key for unlocking plot expansions and upgrades.

Track achievements and use the in-game calendar to plan weekly tasks. Don’t rush—enjoy the journey and explore at your own pace. The game rewards consistency and creativity.

Progression Goals:

  • Max all eight skills
  • Unlock all housing upgrades
  • Complete every villager quest

Conclusion Palia offers a relaxing yet rich experience filled with meaningful progression, social interaction, and creative freedom. By mastering its systems—from skill leveling and crafting to relationships and exploration—you’ll unlock the full potential of life in Kilima and Bahari Bay. Whether you’re farming solo or hosting friends, this guide equips you to thrive in Palia’s cozy world.

blog.title: How to Master Afterimage: A Complete Guide to Exploration, Combat, and Progression in Engardin

meta.og:title: How to Master Afterimage: A Complete Guide to Exploration, Combat, and Progression in Engardin - Best Review & H5 Games Hub
meta.twitter:title: How to Master Afterimage: A Complete Guide to Exploration, Combat, and Progression in Engardin - Best Review & H5 Games Hub

news.content:
Afterimage is a visually stunning Metroidvania that combines fluid combat, deep lore, and non-linear exploration in the ruined world of Engardin. While its hand-drawn art and atmospheric soundtrack draw players in, the game’s true depth lies in its layered mechanics—from traversal and skill upgrades to boss strategies and multiple endings. This guide breaks down the journey into ten progressive sections, helping you navigate the game’s challenges and secrets with confidence.

  1. Understanding the World of Engardin Engardin is vast, interconnected, and filled with secrets. Unlike linear platformers, Afterimage encourages exploration and backtracking. Each region—from the Rainbow Plains to the Sunken Sanctum—has unique enemies, environmental hazards, and lore-rich NPCs.

Use the customizable map system to mark locations of interest. With up to 200 icons and 16 types, you can track inaccessible areas, hidden bosses, and quest-giving characters. This will save time later when you revisit zones with new abilities.

Tips:

  • Mark every locked door, NPC, and treasure chest
  • Use Resting Potions to fast travel between Confluence Trees
  1. Navigating Skill Gates and Traversal Upgrades Progression in Afterimage is tied to traversal abilities like Crimson Dash, Super Jump, and Wall Climb. These are unlocked by defeating specific bosses or acquiring Afterimages tied to story events.

Skill gates are everywhere—some are obvious, like high ledges, while others are hidden behind destructible walls or illusionary terrain. Keep track of these barriers and return once you’ve unlocked the required movement ability.

Essential Abilities:

  • Crimson Dash – unlocked in Goliathfall
  • Super Jump – acquired via Phoenix NPC in Solar Birthplace
  • Wall Climb – found in Whispering Forest
  1. Combat Mechanics and Weapon Types Combat in Afterimage is fast-paced and punishing. You’ll need to master dodging, parrying, and combo timing. Weapons include swords, greatswords, whips, and ranged tools, each with unique attack patterns and scaling attributes.

Experiment with different weapon types to find your preferred style. Some enemies are weak to specific damage types, so switching gear mid-run can be strategic. Don’t forget to upgrade weapons at Resting Trees using collected materials.

Combat Tips:

  • Use light weapons for speed, heavy for stagger
  • Equip ranged tools for flying enemies
  • Upgrade frequently to keep pace with enemy scaling
  1. Managing Afterimages and Passive Skills Afterimages are passive abilities that enhance your stats, movement, or combat. You can equip multiple Afterimages and swap them at Resting Trees. Some grant elemental resistances, while others boost healing or critical damage.

Unlocking new Afterimages often requires defeating bosses or completing side quests. Pay attention to synergy—some Afterimages work better when paired with specific weapons or glyphs.

Recommended Afterimages:

  • Flower of Confluence – enables fast travel
  • Eye of Gongor – boosts vision and detection
  • Glyph of Light – enhances healing and defense
  1. Boss Strategies and Difficulty Scaling Bosses in Afterimage are beautifully animated and brutally difficult. Each has unique attack patterns, elemental affinities, and phase changes. Learn their tells and adjust your gear accordingly.

Use Resting Potions to save progress before tough fights. Some bosses drop key items required for progression or unlocking endings. If you’re stuck, revisit earlier zones to grind for upgrades or find hidden Afterimages.

Boss Prep Checklist:

  • Stock up on healing items
  • Equip elemental resistances
  • Use ranged attacks for mobility
  1. Side Quests and NPC Interactions NPCs in Engardin offer side quests that reveal lore, unlock gear, and provide Afterimages. These quests are often cryptic and require exploration or item collection. Some NPCs move between zones, so revisit towns frequently.

Dialogue choices can affect quest outcomes. Pay attention to hints and mark quest-related locations on your map. Completing side quests is essential for unlocking certain endings and rare gear.

Quest Tips:

  • Talk to every NPC multiple times
  • Track quest items in your inventory
  • Use map icons to mark quest zones
  1. Resource Management and Crafting Resources like healing items, upgrade materials, and Resting Potions are limited. Use them wisely, especially in boss zones. You can craft or purchase items from vendors using currency earned from combat and exploration.

Upgrade your gear at Resting Trees and manage your inventory to avoid clutter. Some items are quest-specific and should not be sold. Keep an eye on your glyph count, which affects health and ability usage.

Resource Tips:

  • Prioritize healing and Resting Potions
  • Upgrade weapons before armor
  • Save rare materials for endgame gear
  1. Unlocking Multiple Endings Afterimage features 10 endings, each tied to specific choices, items, and boss outcomes. You can unlock all endings on a single save file if you manage your Memory Shards and glyphs carefully.

Endings are split between Renee and Ifree paths, with additional NG+ variants. To unlock “The Essential” ending, for example, you must insert 3 Memory Shards and defeat two bosses without restocking healing items.

Ending Paths:

  • Homecoming – basic ending via Sunken Sanctum
  • Journey – Ifree survives with 8 glyphs
  • The Hope – defeat Ifree after soul invasion
  1. Navigating New Game+ and Replayability New Game+ unlocks after completing the main story. You retain gear, Afterimages, and map progress, but enemies are tougher and bosses gain new moves. NG+ also unlocks 3 exclusive endings.

Use NG+ to explore missed areas, complete side quests, and experiment with different builds. The increased difficulty rewards mastery and offers new lore insights.

NG+ Tips:

  • Focus on elemental resistances
  • Revisit marked map zones
  • Try alternate dialogue choices
  1. Final Tips for Completionists To reach 100% completion, you’ll need to uncover every map tile, defeat all bosses, complete side quests, and collect every Afterimage. Use guides and community maps to find hidden paths and secrets.

Track your progress via the in-game menu and Steam achievements. Completion unlocks the Easter Egg ending and rare gear. Be patient—some areas require multiple revisits with new abilities.

Completion Checklist:

  • All 8 glyphs collected
  • All endings unlocked
  • All map zones explored

Conclusion Afterimage is a rich, challenging Metroidvania that rewards exploration, experimentation, and persistence. By mastering traversal, combat, and quest systems, you’ll uncover the full depth of Engardin and its haunting beauty. Whether you’re chasing endings or building the perfect loadout, this guide equips you to make the most of your journey

blog.title: How to Master Noita: A Complete Guide to Surviving the Chaos

meta.og:title: How to Master Noita: A Complete Guide to Surviving the Chaos - Best Review & H5 Games Hub
meta.twitter:title: How to Master Noita: A Complete Guide to Surviving the Chaos - Best Review & H5 Games Hub

news.content:
Noita is more than a roguelike—it’s a living physics simulation where every pixel reacts to the world. Fire spreads, water conducts electricity, and even sand can crush you. It’s both beautiful and brutally punishing. To master it, you need more than quick reflexes; you need understanding. This guide will walk you through every stage of your journey, from your first hesitant dive into the mines to achieving demi-god status through experimentation, knowledge, and patience.

1. Learning to Walk Before You Fly

Your first few runs in Noita will be messy. You’ll blow yourself up, drown in poison, or catch fire from your own torch. That’s okay—dying is learning.

The key early lesson is movement and awareness. Always scan your surroundings before acting. Avoid digging directly beneath liquids and don’t fire wands near flammable materials. Noita rewards caution and punishes panic. Learn to hover carefully and use terrain to block enemies.

Early Game Tips

  • Use water flasks to put out fires and neutralize toxic sludge.
  • Always carry one flask for emergencies.
  • Don’t rush downward — lateral exploration often yields safer rewards.

By the time you can descend confidently into the Coal Pits, you’ve mastered the first real test of control and survival.

2. Understanding Your Tools: Wands and Their Secrets

Every wand in Noita has unique stats—cast delay, recharge time, mana capacity, and spread. These stats define how spells behave. Understanding them is crucial for building effective weapons.

Each spell consumes mana and often has special rules. Some, like “Spark Bolt,” are simple projectiles, while others like “Chainsaw” can modify casting speed. Mixing spells without understanding their properties can create chaos—or deadly combos.

— Wand Experimentation

Pick up every wand you find but test them safely. Firing unknown wands in confined spaces is a rookie mistake. Always test in an open area to avoid explosive surprises.

— Key Stats to Watch

  • Cast Delay: Time between shots.
  • Recharge Time: How long before the wand fires again.
  • Mana: Determines how many spells can be cast in a sequence.
  • Learning to read these stats transforms you from a reckless wizard into a calculated scientist.

3. Spells That Shape the World

Noita’s true magic lies in how spells interact with the environment. Fire burns wood, electricity shocks water, and freezing liquids can create platforms.

The game rewards creative thinking. Combine “Water Trail” with “Spark Bolt” to make conductive paths, or “Explosion on Slimy Enemies” for toxic crowd control. Every discovery feels earned, like solving a puzzle of physics.

— Elemental Interactions

Understanding elemental relationships can save your life:

  • Fire + Oil = Inferno
  • Water + Electricity = Instant Death
  • Ice + Explosives = Controlled Terrain Destruction

— Experiment Safely

Always have an escape route. Set up controlled test zones or use teleportation wands to retreat when experiments go wrong. Mastery of spell interaction defines the difference between surviving a level and blowing yourself up in brilliance.

4. Exploring the Mines Safely

The Mines are Noita’s first and most deceptive area. It seems simple—dig, shoot, collect gold—but every action can trigger chain reactions. A single spark can ignite oil, setting the whole area ablaze.

Take slow, deliberate steps. Dig carefully through soft materials and avoid shooting barrels or lanterns. Enemies like Fire Mages can kill you instantly if you underestimate them.

— Best Early Strategy

  • Stick to horizontal exploration.
  • Collect gold dropped from enemies but avoid fire zones.
  • Use water to create safe paths through acid pools.

— Common Mistakes

Many players die to explosions caused by enemy projectiles or environmental hazards. Remember, your magic manipulates a living world—respect it, or it will bury you.

5. The Holy Mountain: A Place to Rest and Rethink

After each biome, you reach a Holy Mountain—a sanctuary between chaos. This is your workshop, your lab, your only safe space.

Here, you can reroll perks, rebuild wands, and recover health. But this is also where new players make huge mistakes—spending all their gold on random wands without understanding synergy.

— Wand Editing 101

  • Remove weak modifiers like “Triple Cast” if they slow your wand.
  • Experiment with chainsaw or drill spells to reduce cast delay.
  • Combine utility spells like “Teleport Bolt” for safe exploration.

— Perk Selection

Some perks define entire runs. “Extra Life” and “Explosion Immunity” are god-tier; others, like “More Love,” are situational. Build your perk set around your wand loadout and playstyle, not random chance.

6. The Midgame: Coal Pits and Beyond

By now, enemies hit harder, and terrain hazards multiply. The Coal Pits, Snowy Depths, and Hiisi Base introduce new materials like lava, gunpowder, and freezing vapor. Mistakes become lethal.

The trick is adaptability. Swap wands often and always carry one for mobility, one for offense, and one utility wand. Use the environment—freeze water to make paths, or trigger chain reactions to clear enemies without risk.

H3 — Combat Efficiency

Use cover. Don’t tank damage; dodge and manipulate physics to win fights. Drop oil barrels from above or shoot through ice to crush foes.

— Wand Combinations to Try

  • Spark Bolt + Trigger + Explosion = Controlled AOE
  • Drill + Chainsaw = Rapid-fire projectile stream
  • Bouncing Burst + Luminous Drill = Crowd Control King

7. Late Game Power: Perks, Gods, and Chaos

Once you survive the midgame, you begin to glimpse Noita’s true potential. Late-game runs hinge on powerful wands and game-altering perks. Some perks even break core rules—like “Unlimited Spells” or “Trick Blood Money.”

You’ll start to experiment with god-tier builds capable of vaporizing entire biomes. But beware: power invites overconfidence. The more destruction you cause, the easier it is to die to your own chaos.

— Perk Synergy Examples

  • “Explosion Immunity” + “Oil Blood” = Walk through fire like a god.
  • “Extra Mana” + “Always Cast” Wands = Infinite death beams.
  • “Stainless Armour” + Careful play = One of the best defenses.

— Managing Power

Even with overpowered setups, remember that Noita’s world remains lethal. A single misfire, or stray spark, can end a perfect run. Keep humility alongside power.

8. The Alchemy of Survival

Alchemy in Noita is a hidden art. Mixing materials creates new potions with powerful effects: invisibility, flight, even immortality. The system is complex—each material reacts differently.

Start by collecting common liquids: water, blood, oil, and slime. Combine them experimentally in flasks. Learning reactions opens entire new strategies.

— Useful Mixtures

  • Water + Sand = Mud (useful for blocking fire)
  • Slime + Blood = Healing Potion
  • Pheromone + Water = Invisibility when combined with stealth play

— Why Alchemy Matters

Potions become your lifeline. When you understand their potential, you gain a strategic layer beyond simple combat. A well-timed invisibility potion can save you from certain death.

9. Hidden Worlds and Secrets of the Gods

Beneath Noita’s visible world lies a labyrinth of secrets—temples, parallel worlds, and godlike beings. Reaching them requires patience and creativity.

Players who master spell combinations can break terrain, teleport across biomes, and uncover hidden lore. The gods themselves react to your actions—anger them by desecrating Holy Mountains, and you’ll face divine wrath.

— Hidden Areas to Explore

  • The Temple of the Art – endgame challenge with god-tier enemies.
  • The Work (Hell) – final destination for the bravest explorers.
  • Parallel Worlds – endless mirror dimensions for ultimate testing.

— Respecting the Gods

Destroying the wrong structures or killing certain entities can trigger the wrath of Stevari—the God of Earth. Once angered, he becomes nearly unstoppable. Choose your battles carefully.

10. Achieving True Mastery: The Path to Godhood

True mastery in Noita is about control—of chaos, of curiosity, and of fear. The game doesn’t just test skill; it tests restraint. Experienced players don’t rush to victory; they savor discovery.

To become godlike, build custom wands that sustain infinite mana, manipulate spells like “Black Hole” and “Matter Eater,” and learn to control environmental chain reactions deliberately. The endgame becomes an open canvas where your creativity defines your fate.

— Endgame Strategies

  • Create safe teleport zones using “Teleport Bolt” chains.
  • Build self-sustaining wands that recycle mana with modifiers.
  • Use “Circle of Vigor” for passive healing in combat.

— Beyond Victory

Beating the final boss or reaching The Work isn’t the true goal. Mastery is when you can control chaos itself—when you know exactly how to survive any disaster, and create beauty from destruction.

Conclusion

Noita is a game that refuses to hold your hand. It’s ruthless but fair, scientific yet magical. Every death teaches something new. Every victory feels earned. To master it, you must think like both a scientist and an artist—experimenting, observing, and adapting. Learn how the world reacts, how to manipulate it, and how to respect its unpredictability. When you finally survive not by luck but by understanding, you’ll realize that Noita was never about defeating enemies—it was about mastering yourself.

blog.title: How to Farm Resources and Progress Fast in Zenless Zone Zero

meta.og:title: How to Farm Resources and Progress Fast in Zenless Zone Zero - Best Review & H5 Games Hub
meta.twitter:title: How to Farm Resources and Progress Fast in Zenless Zone Zero - Best Review & H5 Games Hub

news.content:
Zenless Zone Zero (ZZZ) is a fast-paced urban RPG where your Agents’ strength depends not only on skill but also on how efficiently you gather resources. From credits and EXP chips to Hollow materials and rare Drive Discs, every system in the game is tied to resource farming. The problem is that energy is limited, resources are scarce, and poor planning can easily stall your progression.

That’s why mastering how to farm resources and progress fast is crucial for both beginners and veterans. This guide explores farming strategies across daily missions, Hollow expeditions, and long-term progression paths, showing you how to get the most out of your time in New Eridu.

Understanding the Resource Economy in ZZZ

Before farming efficiently, you need to understand what resources exist and how they interact with Agent progression.

Core Resource Categories

  • Credits – The universal currency, used for almost every upgrade.
  • EXP Chips – For leveling Agents.
  • Ascension Materials – Unlock level caps and Agent power.
  • Skill Books – Used to upgrade combat abilities.
  • W-Engine & Drive Disc Materials – Strengthen weapons and gear.

Why Resource Management is Key

Unlike some gacha RPGs, ZZZ is stingy with energy and drops. This means you can’t farm endlessly. Every action costs, and planning ahead saves weeks of grind.

Daily Commissions: The Fastest Base Farming

Daily Commissions are your bread and butter for consistent farming. Completing them should be your first action every day.

Benefits of Daily Commissions

  • Reliable credits and EXP items.
  • Small amounts of premium currency.
  • Helps build routine progression.

How to Optimize Them

  • Finish all commissions daily for steady passive growth.
  • Stack rewards by pairing commission runs with material farming.
  • Use weaker Agents in easy missions to train them while still farming.

How to Farm Hollow Expeditions Efficiently

Hollow expeditions are the heart of farming in ZZZ. They give essential materials but drain your limited energy.

Route Planning

Each Hollow has multiple nodes offering combat, resources, or healing. Plan routes carefully to maximize material gain while conserving stamina.

Tips for Hollow Farming

  • Save Ultimates for mini-bosses to clear faster.
  • Target specific nodes that drop the materials you need most.
  • Don’t overfarm low-level Hollows—move up once your team can handle harder tiers.

Credit Farming: How to Avoid Shortages

Credits are deceptively scarce in ZZZ. Almost every upgrade drains them, and running out halts progress.

Sources of Credits

  • Daily commissions.
  • Specific Hollow nodes.
  • Special events or side quests.

Credit Farming Tips

  • Focus spending on your main Agents, not every unit.
  • Avoid wasting credits enhancing Drive Discs with poor stat rolls.
  • Farm dedicated Credit stages when you hit bottlenecks.

Farming EXP Chips for Agent Growth

Leveling is one of the first bottlenecks, as EXP chips run out quickly.

Where to Get EXP Chips

  • Daily missions.
  • Specific Hollow farming routes.
  • Events and log-in rewards.

Efficiency Tips

  • Don’t max every Agent—focus on your primary DPS and key supports.
  • Save higher-level EXP chips for rarer Agents to avoid waste.
  • Farm during double-drop events to maximize return.

How to Farm and Use Ascension Materials

Ascension materials are essential for breaking Agent level caps.

Material Sources

  • Hollow expeditions.
  • Weekly boss drops.
  • Event stores or exchanges.

Farming Strategies

  • Focus on one DPS first to avoid resource dilution.
  • Farm extra materials for future upgrades if you know your next priority Agent.
  • Use planning tools or community drop charts to avoid wasted energy.

Drive Discs and W-Engines: Long-Term Farming

These gear systems offer huge stat boosts, but farming them wrong wastes time.

Drive Disc Farming

  • Don’t farm too early—low-level sets get replaced fast.
  • Prioritize ATK %, Crit Rate, and Crit Damage rolls for DPS.
  • Upgrade only high-quality sets with good stat lines.

W-Engine Materials

  • Focus upgrades on one main W-Engine per role.
  • Don’t over-upgrade weapons for Agents you won’t use long-term.
  • Farm upgrade materials alongside daily credit runs for efficiency.

Energy Management: The Key to Faster Progression

Energy is the most important limiter in ZZZ farming. Mismanagement slows progression dramatically.

Energy Tips

  • Never let energy cap out—log in to spend it regularly.
  • Prioritize farming scarce materials over common ones.
  • Save energy for farming during events with double-drop rewards.

Long-Term Energy Strategy

Use energy daily, even if you can’t play much—set short Hollow runs to keep resources flowing.

Weekly Bosses and Limited Events

Weekly bosses and time-limited events are your highest-value farming opportunities.

Weekly Bosses

  • Drop rare ascension and skill upgrade materials.
  • Have weekly caps, so missing them slows progression permanently.

Events

  • Often provide bonus farming rewards like double credits.
  • Focus your farming during events to maximize long-term efficiency.

Mistakes to Avoid in Farming

Efficient farming is as much about avoiding mistakes as it is about grinding.

Common Farming Mistakes

  • Overfarming weak Hollows – wastes energy.
  • Spreading resources across too many Agents – weakens your team.
  • Enhancing poor Drive Discs – drains credits and materials.

How to Avoid Them

  • Always plan upgrades ahead of time.
  • Prioritize one carry DPS and their best W-Engine before diversifying.
  • Treat energy as your most valuable currency, not just a timer.

Conclusion

Farming resources and progressing fast in Zenless Zone Zero isn’t about endless grinding—it’s about strategy, prioritization, and planning. By focusing on daily commissions, optimizing Hollow expeditions, managing credits and EXP wisely, and targeting ascension materials for your main DPS first, you can avoid common traps and steadily power up your team.

Use energy efficiently, don’t spread resources too thin, and always save farming for double-reward events when possible. With these strategies, you’ll keep your Agents strong, your resources flowing, and your progression smooth, making you always ready to face the toughest Hollows in New Eridu.

blog.title: How to Upgrade Agents Efficiently in Zenless Zone Zero

meta.og:title: How to Upgrade Agents Efficiently in Zenless Zone Zero - Best Review & H5 Games Hub
meta.twitter:title: How to Upgrade Agents Efficiently in Zenless Zone Zero - Best Review & H5 Games Hub

news.content:
Zenless Zone Zero (ZZZ) thrives on stylish, high-paced combat where your success depends heavily on the strength of your Agents. But unlike some action RPGs where brute leveling is enough, ZZZ requires careful, efficient upgrading across multiple systems: leveling, ascensions, skills, W-Engines, drives, and more. For new and even mid-game players, resources are scarce, so wasting them can set you back days or weeks. That’s why knowing how to upgrade your Agents efficiently is one of the most important skills a Proxy can master.

This guide walks you through every aspect of upgrading Agents—what to prioritize, what to skip, and how to plan for long-term growth. From your first free characters to late-game elite squads, we’ll break down all systems step by step.

Understanding the Basics of Agent Growth

Before upgrading, you must understand how Agents grow. ZZZ splits upgrades into different categories, each requiring unique resources.

Main Systems of Growth

  • Leveling – Increases basic stats like HP, ATK, DEF.
  • Ascension – Breaks the level cap, unlocking higher growth potential.
  • Skill Upgrades – Enhance combat performance, raising damage multipliers or utility effects.
  • W-Engines – Weapons that massively affect your DPS or utility role.
  • Drive Discs – Gear-like items that provide stat bonuses and set effects.

Why Efficiency Matters

Resources like credits, ascension materials, and skill books are limited. Without prioritization, you’ll spread upgrades too thin across Agents, leaving no one powerful enough to carry you through difficult Hollows or boss fights.

How to Level Up Agents Efficiently

Leveling is your foundation. But in ZZZ, it’s easy to waste experience items or push the wrong Agent too far too soon.

Focus on Your Core Team

At the start, pick one main DPS and support Agents. Level these first instead of evenly distributing XP across your entire roster. This ensures you always have a reliable unit for tougher battles.

Smart Use of EXP Materials

EXP items like “Basic Strengthening Chips” should be saved for higher rarity Agents once you confirm they fit your team long-term. Don’t overinvest in a character you’ll later replace.

How to Ascend Agents Without Wasting Resources

Level caps hit fast, and Ascension is the only way to unlock higher growth. But it requires farming Hollow materials.

Ascension Materials Strategy

  • Farm efficiently: Check which Hollow expeditions drop the materials you need before spending energy.
  • Plan ahead: Ascension needs specific items for each Agent. Gather extras if you know which Agents you’ll main.

Early Game Advice

Don’t rush to ascend every Agent. Prioritize your strongest DPS first, then your supports. Ascending utility characters too early spreads resources thin.

Prioritizing Skills: Which to Upgrade First

Skill upgrades often provide the biggest leap in combat performance, but they also demand rare books.

Identifying Core Skills

Each Agent has four abilities: Basic Attack, Special Attack, Dodge, and Ultimate. Typically, DPS Agents benefit most from leveling Basic + Special Attacks, while Supports need upgrades in utility-based skills.

Upgrade Path Example

  • DPS Agent: Special Attack → Ultimate → Basic Attack
  • Support Agent: Buff/Debuff Skill → Ultimate
  • Utility Agent: Stamina-related or survivability skills

How to Optimize W-Engines (Weapons)

W-Engines are not just stat sticks—they define your playstyle. But enhancing them consumes rare materials.

Choosing the Right W-Engine

  • Use free 4★ W-Engines early until you obtain signature 5★ ones.
  • Avoid enhancing every W-Engine; focus on one per core Agent.

Efficient Enhancement

Enhance a DPS Agent’s W-Engine first since it scales damage fastest. For supports, hold off until you stabilize your DPS weapon at a competitive level.

How to Farm and Use Drive Discs

Drive Discs are ZZZ’s version of artifact sets. They’re powerful but tricky to optimize efficiently.

Farming Tips

  • Don’t farm heavily until mid-game. Early Drive Discs will be replaced quickly.
  • Focus on farming sets that match your team’s playstyle (e.g., ATK % sets for DPS).

Efficient Upgrading

Upgrade only the pieces with good main stats. For DPS, prioritize ATK %, Crit Rate, and Crit Damage. Avoid wasting materials on weak rolls.

Balancing Resources Between Multiple Agents

Many players make the mistake of splitting resources across too many Agents at once. Efficiency means focusing.

One Carry Strategy

Invest heavily in one DPS Agent first. This Agent becomes your Hollow expedition carry while others support them.

Support Scaling Later

Once your carry is maxed to a comfortable level, then shift resources into supports for long-term balance.

Daily and Weekly Resource Management

Your progression speed depends on how well you use daily and weekly systems.

Daily Priorities

  • Spend energy on Hollow expeditions for materials.
  • Complete commissions for credits.
  • Farm EXP chips sparingly until you know your main roster.

Weekly Goals

Target bosses that drop high-level ascension and skill upgrade materials. Weekly resets are limited, so focus on the characters you plan to ascend soon.

Mistakes to Avoid in Upgrading Agents

Even experienced players fall into traps that waste resources.

Common Mistakes

  • Overleveling low-rarity Agents – they won’t carry you long-term.
  • Upgrading every skill evenly – some skills barely impact combat.
  • Enhancing too many W-Engines – spread investment weakens your main team.

How to Avoid Them

Always plan around your long-term team composition and consult tier lists or community data before spending rare resources.

Endgame Efficiency: Long-Term Upgrade Planning

Once you’ve built your initial team, efficiency shifts from survival to optimization.

Targeted Farming

Farm Drive Discs with the exact stat lines you need. At this stage, rerolling and refining gear becomes your main grind.

Team Optimization

Balance upgrades across your roster so you can switch Agents based on Hollow mechanics and boss resistances. Efficiency here means versatility, not just power stacking.

Conclusion

Upgrading Agents in Zenless Zone Zero is a marathon, not a sprint. Efficient growth means focusing on one core DPS and complementary supports, upgrading skills strategically, and resisting the temptation to waste resources on every Agent. By understanding the value of each system—levels, ascensions, skills, W-Engines, and Drive Discs—you can maximize your power while conserving materials.

Approach upgrades with patience and planning, and you’ll always have a squad ready to face the toughest Hollows New Eridu has to offer.

How to Get Started

Downloading and Installing the Game

The first step to your adventure in Toca Life World is to download and install the game on your device.

  1. For Mobile Devices:
  • iOS: Open the App Store, search for "Toca Life World," and tap "Get" to download the game.
  • Android: Launch the Google Play Store, search for "Toca Life World," and tap "Install."
  1. Creating an Account:
  • After installation, launch the game.
  • Creating a Toca Boca account allows you to save your progress and unlock additional features. Follow the prompts to set up your account.

Navigating the Main Menu

Once you enter Toca Life World, you’ll see the main menu. Familiarizing yourself with this interface is essential for a smooth gaming experience.

  • Play: Click here to start your adventures and explore various locations.
  • Store: Access additional characters, locations, and items available for purchase to enhance your gameplay.
  • Settings: Adjust sound, notifications, and parental controls according to your preferences.

Customizing Your Experience

Customization is a key feature of Toca Life World. Here’s how to tailor the game to your liking:

  • Character Customization: Choose and modify your characters to fit your narrative. Change their outfits, hairstyles, and accessories to create unique personas.
  • Environment Customization: Personalize locations with furniture and decorations available in the store, allowing you to create distinctive settings for your stories.

How to Explore the Game World

Understanding Different Locations

Toca Life World features a variety of locations, each offering unique experiences and activities. Familiarizing yourself with these locations can enhance your gameplay.

  • City: This central hub is where most activities take place. You can find shops, cafes, and entertainment venues here, making it a vibrant area for social interactions among characters.
  • Hospital: A fun place for medical adventures, where characters can engage in scenarios involving doctors and patients, enabling creative storytelling related to health and care.
  • School: An educational setting where characters can attend classes, participate in events, and explore friendships, encouraging imaginative play centered around learning.

Interacting with Characters and Objects

Interaction is a core mechanic in Toca Life World. Learning how to engage effectively with characters and objects allows for dynamic storytelling.

  1. Tap on Characters: Characters can be made to speak, dance, or perform various actions when tapped. This interaction adds life to your stories.
  2. Pick Up Objects: Items can be dragged and dropped in different locations or used in various scenarios, enhancing your gameplay. Experiment with different combinations to see how they can enhance your narratives.

Utilizing Hidden Features

Toca Life World is filled with hidden features and Easter eggs that can make your gameplay even more enjoyable.

  • Secret Areas: Some locations may have hidden areas that can be accessed by interacting with specific objects or completing tasks. Always be on the lookout for anything unusual.
  • Special Events: Occasionally, Toca Life World hosts special events that introduce new characters or items. Participating in these events can enrich your gameplay experience.

How to Create Your Own Stories

Developing Your Characters

Characters are the heart of any story in Toca Life World. Here’s how to develop them effectively:

  • Customize their appearance—change their clothes, hairstyles, and accessories to fit your narrative.
  1. Building Backgrounds:
  • Create backstories for your characters to add depth to your stories. Consider their motivations, dreams, and fears to make them relatable.
  • Explore their relationships with other characters; this can significantly influence your storytelling. Think about how their interactions might develop over time.

  • Emphasize Emotions: Highlight your characters' feelings to create a deeper connection with the audience. Emotional storytelling can make your narratives more impactful.

Sharing your stories and creations with friends can enhance the overall experience. Here’s how to do it effectively:

  • Screenshots: Capture your favorite moments in the game and share them on social media platforms. This allows you to showcase your creativity and storytelling.
  • Storytelling: Discuss your character narratives with friends to inspire collaborative storytelling and role-play. This can lead to new ideas and enrich your gameplay experience.

Engaging with Online Communities

Connecting with other players can provide inspiration and new ideas for your adventures.

  • Follow Toca Boca: Stay updated with Toca Boca on social media for news, contests, and community highlights. Engaging with the community can keep your gameplay fresh and exciting.
  • Join Online Forums: Participate in forums and groups to discuss strategies, share tips, and showcase your stories. Learning from others can help you improve your gameplay.

Game Performance Problems

If you encounter performance issues while playing, consider these solutions:

  • Check for Updates: Keeping the game updated can help avoid bugs and performance issues that hinder gameplay. Regular updates can improve the overall experience.
  • Restart the Device: Sometimes, a simple restart can resolve performance problems and refresh the system. This can help improve loading times and gameplay smoothness.

In-Game Purchase Concerns

If you're concerned about in-game purchases, here are some helpful tips:

  • Review Spending: Regularly check the account for unexpected charges and monitor in-game purchases. Keeping an eye on spending can help prevent accidental purchases.
  • Set Limits: Use parental controls to manage and limit in-game spending, avoiding accidental purchases. Setting clear guidelines can help children understand responsible gaming.

Developing Advanced Storylines

As you become more skilled at Toca Life World, consider developing more intricate storylines.

  • Subplots: Introduce secondary characters and conflicts that add richness to your narratives, making them more engaging. Subplots can provide depth and realism to your stories.
  • Character Arcs: Allow characters to grow and evolve throughout the story, making them more relatable and compelling. Character development can significantly enhance your storytelling.

Role-playing can significantly enhance the immersive experience of Toca Life World.

  • Act Out Scenarios: Engage in role-playing with friends or family to fully explore your stories and enhance the fun. This can lead to spontaneous storytelling and creative collaboration.

Conclusion

Toca Life World is a delightful platform that encourages creativity and storytelling in a fun and interactive way. By understanding the game’s mechanics, exploring its rich environments, and engaging in character development, players can unlock endless possibilities for imaginative play. Whether you're crafting intricate narratives or simply enjoying the colorful world, Toca Life World offers a rewarding experience for children and families alike.
